questions.question: What would you do if you won a prize?
suggested_answers: I would share the prize with my family and friends.
I would keep some of it and give some to charity.
I would buy something useful and save the rest for the future.

questions.question: Why is it important to be honest with others?
questions.translation: لماذا من المهم أن تكون صادقاً مع الآخرين؟
suggested_answers: It is important to be honest because it builds trust between people.
Honesty brings respect and makes relationships stronger.
When you tell the truth, people believe you and respect you.

questions.question: What values do you think are most important in life?
questions.translation: ما القيم التي تعتقد أنها الأهم في الحياة؟
suggested_answers: I think honesty, respect, and kindness are the most important values.
Family, love, and trust are the values I care about most.
In my opinion, patience and helping others are the most important values.

questions.question: What does it mean to be a responsible citizen?
questions.translation: ماذا يعني أن تكون مواطناً مسؤولاً؟
suggested_answers: A responsible citizen follows the rules and respects others.
It means helping your community and keeping the environment clean.
A responsible citizen respects the law and helps people in need.

questions.question: Who inspires you to be a better person?
suggested_answers: My mother inspires me to be a better person because she is kind and patient.
My father inspires me because he works hard and helps everyone.
My teacher inspires me because she always helps others and gives a good example.

questions.question: What would you do if you found a wallet on the street?
questions.translation: ماذا ستفعل لو وجدت محفظة في الشارع؟
suggested_answers: I would try to return the wallet to its owner.
I would take it to the police so they can find the owner.
I would look for an ID card inside and try to contact the owner.

questions.question: How can young people make a difference in their community?
questions.translation: كيف يمكن للشباب إحداث فرق في مجتمعهم؟
suggested_answers: Young people can volunteer and help others in their community.
They can clean the streets, plant trees, and recycle to protect the environment.
They can donate books, teach children, or organise charity events.

questions.question: Why is it important to respect others?
suggested_answers: It is important to respect others because it brings peace and kindness.
Respecting others builds trust and makes people feel good.
When we respect each other, society becomes better and stronger.
